info.name: OpenSea Account Endpoints NFT Endpoints API

items.docs: Retrieve multiple NFTs in a single request by providing a list of identifiers (chain, contract address, and token ID). Not-found NFTs are silently omitted from the response.

params.name: chain
params.description: The blockchain on which the NFT exists

params.name: address
params.description: The contract address

params.name: identifier
params.description: The NFT token id

params.name: ignoreCachedItemUrls
params.description: Whether to bypass cached SeaDN URLs

items.docs: Fetch and validate NFT metadata directly from the blockchain without using cached data. Returns both original and processed (SeaDN) URLs to show how the metadata would be ingested. This endpoint does not persist any data.

params.name: address
params.description: Contract address

params.name: chain
params.description: Blockchain chain identifier

params.name: identifier
params.description: Token identifier

items.docs: Queue a metadata refresh for a specific NFT to update its information from the blockchain.

info.name: Transfer NFTs or tokens between wallets

items.docs: Returns ordered blockchain actions to execute for transferring one or more NFTs or tokens from one wallet to another. Supports bulk transfers of multiple assets in a single request.

params.name: chain
params.description: The blockchain on which to filter the results

params.name: contractAddress
params.description: The unique public blockchain identifier for the contract

params.name: tokenId
params.description: The NFT token id

items.docs: Get detailed metadata for an NFT including name, description, image, traits, and external links.

params.name: slug
params.description: Collection slug

params.name: traits
params.description: JSON array of trait filters. Each object has 'traitType' and 'value' fields. Multiple traits are AND-combined (items must match all). Example: [{"traitType":"Background","value":"Red"}]

params.name: has_agent_binding
params.description: Filter by NFTs that have an ERC-8217 agent binding

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items to return per page

items.docs: Get NFTs in a specific collection. Optionally filter by traits using the 'traits' query parameter with a JSON array of trait filters. Multiple traits are AND-combined (items must match all specified traits). Example: ?traits=[{"traitType":"Background","value":"Red"},{"traitType":"Eyes","value":"Blue"}]

params.name: address
params.description: Contract address

params.name: chain
params.description: Blockchain chain identifier

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items to return per page

params.name: chain
params.description: The blockchain on which to filter the results

params.name: address
